gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i1: Tests {@link CharSet#contains(char)} for the different ways a set of characters can be described.
ADDED i2: "b-d": the range b..d, so it contains b, c and d but nothing outside.
ADDED i3: "bcd": the same three characters listed individually -> same membership.
ADDED i4: "bd": only the two characters b and d (c is NOT included).
ADDED i5: "^b-d": the negation of b..d, so it contains everything except b, c and d.
ADDED i6: "d-b": a reversed range, which CharSet normalises to the same range as "b-d".
ADDED i7: The reversed range is stored as the single, normalised range "b-d".
ADDED i8: Asserts that the given set contains exactly the characters b, c and d, i.e. it covers the range b..d and excludes the immediate neighbours a and e.
